items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I was playing with all these top guys. I mean everybody on that album was tops. And I was relatively new to playing with guys of that caliber. After moving to New York I started meeting guys like Dan Barrett, who introduced me to some of these other guys.

ctx.x: A little bit, yeah, yeah. In a way it was really my second recording session. The other one came out later so I say that this was my first CD because it came out first. Yeah, I mean I was playing with all these top guys. I mean everybody on that album was tops. And I was relatively new to playing with guys of that caliber. After moving to New York I started meeting guys like Dan Barrett, who introduced me to some of these other guys. It was a thrill. It was exciting. I was more uptight then about like wanting…
